Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh + 40 fps cap is the sweet spot for Sea of Thieves on Deck — the game's fluid ocean animations feel noticeably smoother than 30 fps, and the TDP stays well within the battery budget. Textures are kept at High because the game's art style relies on them, while costlier effects like reflections and volumetrics are kept at Medium.

profiles.Summary: Sea of Thieves runs on the Steam Deck with Proton and is Steam Deck Verified, though its online-only nature means a stable internet connection is essential. The RDNA 2 GPU sits between the minimum and recommended PC specs, so medium-to-low settings with FSR upscaling are needed to maintain smooth frame rates.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended specs relative to the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU and community ProtonDB tier data. On first launch, check frame rates in a busy port (the most demanding area) and adjust the Overall Quality preset up or down from the Optimal profile accordingly.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with Deck FSR upscaling to 1280x800 keeps GPU load low; water and volumetric effects are the biggest power hogs so they are set to Low. A manual GPU clock of 900 MHz prevents the GPU from boosting unnecessarily and saves significant battery.

KnownIssues: Online-only game — any network interruption will disconnect you mid-session, which is more likely on portable Wi-Fi.
ProtonDB trending gold (not platinum) suggests occasional issues such as crashes or launcher quirks that may require workarounds.
High VRAM pressure from shared 16 GB pool can cause stutters in busy ports or large sea battles.
No native Linux build; runs via Proton, so future anti-cheat or update changes could temporarily break compatibility.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full native resolution at max TDP can hit 60 fps in open-ocean sailing but will dip to 45-50 fps in busy ports or during ship battles — consider dropping Water Quality to Low if dips are frequent. Battery life will be short, so this profile is best for docked or plugged-in play.

Optimal.Notes: 40 Hz refresh with a 40 fps cap is the sweet spot — motion feels smooth and the GPU clock headroom keeps frame pacing consistent during sea storms and combat. Option names are based on typical Sea of Thieves PC settings; confirm in-game.

profiles.Summary: Sea of Thieves runs on the Steam Deck at Gold tier on ProtonDB, generally playable but may require some Proton tweaking for online connectivity and stability. The game's open-world ocean environments and dynamic weather are moderately demanding, sitting above the Deck's GPU class, so medium-to-low settings with FSR upscaling are needed to maintain a stable frame rate.
profiles.BasisNote: No Steam Deck–specific reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements relative to Deck GPU capability (roughly GTX 1050 Ti class) and ProtonDB Gold tier status. On first run, check frame rate in a busy port or during a storm — if it dips below 30 fps on the Optimal profile, switch to Max Battery settings.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at sub-native with Deck FSR to relieve GPU pressure; 8 W TDP and locked 30 fps keep thermals and fan noise low for long sessions. Option names are based on typical Sea of Thieves PC settings — verify labels in-game on first launch.

KnownIssues: Online multiplayer connectivity can be unreliable under certain Proton versions; switching to Proton Experimental may help.
The game uses DirectX 12 at recommended settings which can cause stutter on first launch while shaders compile.
No native Linux build — runs via Proton, and some players report occasional crashes during session transitions.
HDR output is not functional under Proton/Linux; the OLED display will render in SDR only.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full native resolution at uncapped performance — expect 50+ fps in calm open sea but dips to 40 fps during storms, port areas, and large ship battles; consider dropping to 45 fps cap if frame pacing feels uneven. Option names are based on typical Sea of Thieves PC settings.
